verdict.rationale: Adyen documents an official MCP server that lets users work with Adyen in natural language through their chosen LLM client (docs-17, probe-4). This requires bringing your own LLM client, and the evidence does not show which operations are exposed or whether the Agentic Commerce features can be driven this way. The other docs describe shopper-facing AI agents transacting with merchants, not users operating the product by natural language. Missing for 10: a native natural-language interface, documentation of which operations the MCP server exposes, coverage of Agentic Commerce flows via natural language, independent or hands-on corroboration.
